name: Refactor Chat.vue - Use Collapsible for File list & profiles
description:
## Chat.vue Refactoring

Use Collapsible component for better UX with truncated headers and expandable details.

### Requirements

#### File List
- [ ] Replace current File list display with Collapsible component
- [ ] In header view: show truncated file count/preview only
- [ ] In detail view: show full expanded file list
- [ ] Implement smooth expand/collapse animation

#### Profiles List
- [ ] Apply same Collapsible pattern to profiles
- [ ] Truncate in header view (show count or first few profiles)
- [ ] Full list in detail/expanded view
- [ ] Maintain profile selection functionality

#### General Lists in Header
- [ ] Apply collapsible pattern to other relevant lists in header
- [ ] Ensure consistent UI/UX across all list components
- [ ] Preserve all existing functionality

## Acceptance Criteria
- ✅ File list uses Collapsible component
- ✅ Profiles use Collapsible component  
- ✅ Truncation works in header mode
- ✅ Expansion works in detail mode
- ✅ All lists properly collapse/expand
- ✅ No data loss during interactions
